nodes.summary: For a quantifier $p$ and a quantifier prefix $(q_1, v_1), \dots, (q_n, v_n)$, the number of indices $1 \le i \le n$ with $q_i \ne q_{i-1}$, where $q_0 = p$.
nodes.title: Quantifier alternations after a given quantifier

nodes.summary: The number of maximal blocks of consecutive equal quantifiers in a quantifier prefix $(q_1, v_1), \dots, (q_n, v_n)$: it is $0$ if $n = 0$, and otherwise $1$ plus the number of indices $2 \le i \le n$ with $q_i \ne q_{i-1}$.
nodes.title: Number of quantifier blocks

nodes.summary: Let $P$ be a quantifier prefix, a list of pairs $(q, v)$ of a quantifier $q$, $\exists$ (true) or $\forall$ (false), and a variable $v \in \mathbb{N}$; let $\varphi$ be a matrix circuit and $\alpha$ an assignment of a truth value to every natural number. nodes.title: Truth of a quantified Boolean formula with circuit matrix

nodes.summary: Given a matrix circuit $C = (g_0, \dots, g_{m-1})$, a list of gates, and an assignment $\alpha$ of a truth value to every natural number, the list $(s_0, \dots, s_{m-1})$ of the values of the gates of $C$, where $s_i$ is the value of the gate $g_i$ given the values $(s_0, \dots, s_{i-1})$ of the earlier gates and the assignment $\alpha$.
nodes.title: Evaluation of a QBF matrix circuit

nodes.summary: For a matrix circuit $C$, a list of gates, the list of the variables $v$ of the gates of $C$ of the form $(0, [v])$, in the order of the gates of $C$ and with repetitions.
nodes.title: Variables of a QBF matrix circuit

nodes.summary: A matrix circuit $C = (g_0, \dots, g_{m-1})$, a list of gates, is well formed when for every $j < m$ whose gate $g_j = (t, r)$ has kind $t \in \{2, 3, 4\}$ (negation, conjunction or disjunction), every reference $a$ in $r$ satisfies $a < j$.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
